headlines.title: 香港证监会：对耀才证券作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元
headlines.summary: 香港证监会对耀才证券国际（香港）有限公司（耀才）作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元，原因是该公司没有实施充足而有效的内部监控程序，以监察和侦测由其客户进行的清洗交易。香港证监会的调查发现，于2023年11月1日至2025年9月13日期间，由于耀才的内部监控措施不足，导致615个客户帐户执行了1,021对涉及736只股票及权证的清洗交易。香港证监会亦发现，由于耀才在2024年3月前主要依赖交易后监察及人手审查来识别可疑交易活动，客户因而得以在被侦测前进行清洗交易。（香港证监会网站）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC reprimands Bright Smart Securities and imposes a fine of HKD 2.8 million
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong SFC reprimands and fines Bright Smart Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited HKD 2.8 million for failing to implement adequate and effective internal controls to monitor and detect wash trades by its clients. SFC investigation found that between 1 November 2023 and 13 September 2025, due to insufficient internal controls, 615 client accounts executed 1,021 pairs of wash trades involving 736 stocks and warrants. The SFC also found that because Bright Smart relied mainly on post-trade monitoring and manual reviews to identify suspicious trading activity until March 2024, clients were able to conduct wash trades before detection. (Hong Kong SFC website)

headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布“强迫劳动”301调查最终措施答记者问
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布“强迫劳动”301调查最终措施答记者问。 问：美东时间7月23日，美国贸易代表办公室依据“未禁止进口强迫劳动产品”301调查结果，发布最终措施，对包括中国在内的60个经济体加征301关税，对华加征12.5%的301关税。请问中方对此有何回应？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对强迫劳动，建立了完善的劳动法律法规体系，坚决防范和打击强迫劳动行为。反观美方，不仅仍未批准加入《1930年强迫劳动公约》，还长期操弄“强迫劳动”议题，此次又以“强迫劳动”为由发起301调查并加征单边关税，是典型的单边主义、保护主义行为，中方对此坚决反对。

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson responds to U.S. final measures on 'forced labor' Section 301 investigation
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson responds to US release of final measures from 'forced labor' Section 301 investigation. Q: On July 23 Eastern Time, the USTR released final measures based on the Section 301 investigation on 'Not Importing Forced Labor Products,' imposing Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies including China, with an additional 12.5% tariff on China. What is China's response? A: We have noted the situation. China consistently opposes forced labor, has established a comprehensive labor legal system, and firmly prevents and combats forced labor. The US, by contrast, has not ratified the 1930 Forced Labor Convention and has long manipulated the 'forced labor' issue. This latest Section 301 investigation and unilateral tariff imposition on the grounds of 'forced labor' are typical unilateralism and protectionism, which China firmly opposes.

headlines.title_en: Bright Smart Securities responds to HKD 2.8 million fine from Hong Kong SFC: sincerely accepts penalty
headlines.summary_en: According to Hong Kong Commercial Daily, the Hong Kong SFC reprimands Bright Smart Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited and fines it HKD 2.8 million for failing to implement adequate and effective internal controls to monitor and detect wash trades by clients. Bright Smart Securities responded that it sincerely accepts the penalty decision, completed all improvements by September 2025, and now all internal control technologies meet regulatory requirements. The incident does not involve technical security issues nor affect any client's normal trading or fund safety.

headlines.title: 美宣称拟对中国人工智能企业开展调查并实施制裁 商务部回应
headlines.summary: 问：近日，美国一些高级官员公开表示将针对中国人工智能企业所谓“蒸馏”美前沿模型开展调查，并可能以“窃取美国知识产权”等为由制裁中国企业。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对美方将科技经贸问题政治化、工具化，以各种莫须有的理由污名化中国企业并实施制裁。美方罔顾有关中国企业人工智能模型与美前沿模型发布时间非常接近、中国部分模型能力已处于领先地位等事实，给中国企业扣上所谓依靠“蒸馏”“窃取美国知识产权”等帽子，还威胁进行打压制裁。这些做法缺乏事实依据，没有法理支撑，在实践上搞双重标准，属于典型的人工智能霸权主义行径。

headlines.title_en: U.S. claims to investigate and impose sanctions on Chinese AI companies; MOFCOM responds
headlines.summary_en: Q: Recently, some senior US officials have publicly stated they will investigate Chinese AI companies for alleged 'distillation' of US frontier models and may sanction Chinese firms on grounds such as 'stealing US intellectual property.' What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. China consistently opposes the US politicizing and instrumentalizing technological and trade issues, stigmatizing Chinese companies with baseless accusations, and imposing sanctions. The US, ignoring facts that some Chinese AI models were released very close to US frontier models and that some Chinese models are already leading, has labeled Chinese companies as relying on 'distillation' or 'stealing US IP' and threatened suppression and sanctions. These actions lack factual basis, legal support, employ double standards in practice, and are typical AI hegemonic behavior.

headlines.title: 蓝盾光电：筹划发行股份及支付现金购买资产并募集配套资金事项，股票停牌
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月27日讯，蓝盾光电公告，公司正筹划发行股份及支付现金购买资产并募集配套资金事项，因有关事项尚存在不确定性，为了维护投资者利益，避免对公司证券交易造成重大影响，根据深圳证券交易所的相关规定，经公司申请，公司股票自2026年7月27日开市起停牌。公司预计在不超过10个交易日的时间内披露本次交易方案，即在2026年8月10日前按照《公开发行证券的公司信息披露内容与格式准则第26号——上市公司重大资产重组》的要求披露相关信息。

headlines.title: 中上协：上半年全市场新增首发上市公司71家，首发募资总额705.74亿元
headlines.summary: 中国上市公司协会发布6月统计月报。数据显示，截至2026年6月30日，境内股票市场共有上市公司5535家，沪、深、北证券交易所分别为2314家、2898家、323家。分股份类型看，仅发A股公司5263家，A+H、A+B等多股份类型公司265家，仅发B股公司7家。

headlines.title_en: China Association for Public Companies: In H1, 71 new IPO companies were listed market-wide, with total IPO proceeds of 70.574 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The China Association for Public Companies released its June statistical monthly report. Data shows that as of June 30, 2026, there were 5,535 listed companies in the domestic stock market, with 2,314 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, 2,898 on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, and 323 on the Beijing Stock Exchange. By share type, there were 5,263 companies issuing only A-shares, 265 companies with multiple share types such as A+H and A+B, and 7 companies issuing only B-shares.
